what: On Today's "Came in today with an ended plan or fees due" card, add a "Renew" or "Take payment" button beside each name, next to Message
why: The member is standing at the desk, yet the only button opens a WhatsApp message; taking the money needs a tap into the member page, then another into renew or payment
impact_why: Money is collected at the moment the member is in front of the desk, every rush hour
my_view: My view: do it; the row already knows the amount due and whether the plan ended, so one button can open the right form. Keep Message for members who left already.

what: An enquiry saved with no follow-up date should come back into "Due" after 3 days instead of waiting in "Later" for ever
why: The add form starts with tomorrow, but if the desk clears the date the person is never on the morning call list again and is quietly lost
impact_why: Every lost walk-in is a lost first month fee
my_view: My view: do it; a small rule change in one place, no new screen. Show "no date set, asked 3 days ago" so the desk knows why it is back.

what: Give enquiries a few follow-up messages for each stage (first call back, free trial invite, an offer, a last try) and count the tries, suggesting "Lost" after the third
why: Today there is one follow-up message for every stage, so the second and third chase repeat the first; GymBook and Wellyx (as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live) offer stage templates and attempt counts
impact_why: Most joins come on the second or third follow-up; a different message each time reads less like spam
my_view: My view: worth doing after the desk is using enquiries daily; start with three fixed templates, no editor, and reuse the lost reasons that already exist.

what: Let the automatic "Plan ends soon / today / ended" reminders carry a way to pay: a UPI pay link with the exact amount, or the gym's online renew where it is switched on
why: The app reminders all say "Renew at the desk", while the panel's own WhatsApp renewal message already carries a UPI link with the amount
impact_why: Renewal is the gym's main money; one tap to pay beats a trip to the desk
my_view: My view: do it, after the open finding that many app members get no reminder at all is fixed; otherwise the better words reach nobody.

what: Add an automatic "Fees due" reminder case (off by default, some days after the plan started), so part-paid members get a polite nudge without the owner messaging each one
why: The automatic reminders cover plan ending, birthdays and offers, but not money still owed; the dues list exists and is sorted oldest first, yet chasing it is all by hand
impact_why: Old dues are the money owners most often never collect
my_view: My view: worth it, but off by default and never for terms that have not started (the panel already treats those as not owed). Needs his yes on the words members see.

what: Make the automatic "We haven't seen you" reminder use each member's own rhythm (the same rule the Away list uses), then offer it switched on
why: The reminder is off by default and waits a flat 14 days, while the Away list already judges each member by how often they usually train
impact_why: Catching a member at the first slip is the cheapest save in a gym
my_view: My view: good idea; one rule for "stopped coming" everywhere also narrows the gap the owner sees between lists. Kind words only, as today.

what: When a member's plan ends without a renewal, or the member is archived, ask "why did they leave?" with the same short list enquiries use (price, too far, timings, joined another gym, other)
why: Your growth counts members lost each month but never why; enquiries already capture a lost reason, members do not
impact_why: Knowing that most leavers cite timings or price tells the owner what to change
my_view: My view: do it as an optional one-tap chip on the member page, never a forced question; show the top reason on Your growth.

what: On Expenses, add "Copy last month's fixed costs" so rent, salary and electricity can be entered for a new month in one tap
why: Rent and salaries repeat every month, but each month starts empty and the owner types the same lines again
impact_why: Profit is only right when expenses are typed; fewer taps means more owners keep it up
my_view: My view: do it; copy, then let the owner change any amount before saving. No automatic repeating entries.

what: When a member import finishes, offer "Send these members the app link" right on the done card
why: The done card offers Members, the skipped-rows file and Start over; the app link is a separate Get started step in Settings, so the moment the owner has a full member list is not used to bring them into the app
impact_why: Members in the app are what make reminders, offers and check-ins work for the gym
my_view: My view: do it; a link to the existing invite screen, filtered to the members just imported. No bulk sending.

what: Ask for a friend referral at the happy moments: the "One year with you" wish, a challenge win and a renewal receipt, naming the gym's free days for a friend
why: The gym's refer-a-friend free days exist, but nothing reminds members at the moments they are most likely to say yes; the anniversary wish is off by default
impact_why: Referred members join at a higher rate than any ad, and cost only the free days
my_view: My view: worth trying on the anniversary wish first (one line added when the gym gives free days); measure joins from referrals before adding more places.
